posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina shared a wholesome May photo dump featuring family time with Vicky Kaushal and rare glimpses of baby Vihaan, while fans went wild over her new hairstyle.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit announced a historic Wembley Stadium show for September 12 — the first South Asian artist to headline the venue — and surprised Toronto AURA Tour fans with the Main Vaapas Aaunga trailer.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia's YRF Spy Universe film Alpha has been preponed to July 3, 2026, where she plays a trained assassin in a completely new direction for the franchise. Bobby Deol shut down on-set clash rumors, calling her 'very professional.'

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka confirmed six months of shooting remain for SS Rajamouli's epic Varanasi (₹1,300 crore budget) with Mahesh Babu, which may include a historic Antarctica schedule.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK broke the internet with his new ₹5.5 crore imported Cadillac Escalade, while his film King with Suhana Khan's debut is confirmed for Christmas 2026 with a ₹350 crore budget.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena wrapped shooting for Meghna Gulzar's thriller Daayra with Prithviraj Sukumaran and is in advanced talks to reunite with Salman Khan for a Raj & DK superhero film.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha is in talks to star opposite Vicky Kaushal in Maddock Films' mythological epic Mahavatar, and has locked a period musical drama as her next project after the blockbuster Stree 2.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika is confirmed as the female lead in Allu Arjun's sci-fi superhero film Raaka directed by Atlee, while also joining SRK's King and gearing up for Kalki 2.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer's Dhurandhar 2 hits JioHotstar on June 4 after an epic ₹1,800 crore worldwide theatrical run — the second-highest-grossing Indian film ever. His next film Pralay begins shooting in August.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Madhuri Dixit and Kangana Ranaut rallied behind Aishwarya after body-shaming trolls targeted her Cannes 2026 appearance, with Madhuri declaring 'You cannot reduce her to a number.'

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika is promoting Cocktail 2 (June 19 release) alongside Shahid Kapoor and Kriti Sanon, while sharing couple goals from her Japan honeymoon with Vijay Deverakonda.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha is producing and starring in Maa Inti Bangaram under her own banner Tralala Moving Pictures, with Gulshan Devaiah joining the cast for a gun-wielding thriller.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's next mega project Raaka with director Atlee is in production — a sci-fi superhero spectacle under Sun Pictures co-starring Deepika Padukone.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's sports action drama Peddi with Janhvi Kapoor releases June 4, with his bodyguard Kevin Kunta — an MMA fighter — going viral during promotional events.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's Dragon glimpse smashed 105 million YouTube views in one week — the third-highest in Indian cinema history — with 64 million views in the first 24 hours alone.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi co-stars with Ram Charan in the much-anticipated Peddi releasing June 4, and turned heads at the film's massive promotional events.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya celebrated turning 27 with love from Suhana Khan and is leading the summer bangs hair trend alongside Priyanka and Shraddha, while promoting her film Chand Mera Dil.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara is embracing motherhood with daughter Saraayah and gearing up for her next big role as Nadia in Yash's gangster film Toxic, one of the most anticipated releases of 2026.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik's War 2 with Jr NTR crossed 500K interest on BookMyShow, joining an elite club of just seven Bollywood films. He's also confirmed to make his directorial debut with Krrish 4.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's romantic comedy Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai with Mrunal Thakur and Pooja Hegde releases June 5 — the first major Bollywood film post-IPL season.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya released the devotional song 'Siddha Bhajo' as a heartfelt tribute to her father, and is gearing up for 'The Unstoppable Tour' across India and Australia this June.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman reunites with Shekhar Kapur as composer and co-producer for Masoom: The New Generation, and joins the JBL Music Academy 2026 as a mentor alongside Martin Garrix.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay's farewell film Jananayagan is eyeing a release window after Tamil Nadu elections, with a ₹500 crore+ budget making it one of the most expensive Indian films ever.
